text.autoconfig.moretabplayers.title: More Tab Players Settings
text.autoconfig.moretabplayers.option.en:
Toggle the mod on/off. If disabled, vanilla limits (80 total players, 20 per column) are used.
Keybind: i (configurable in settings)
text.autoconfig.moretabplayers.option.ma:
The maximum number of players shown in the tab list.
Mod Default: 260, Vanilla: 80

How many players to display vertically before creating a new column.
Mod Default: 40, Vanilla: 20
